newsitem.title: USA: Wellman sees poor showings in Q3 and Q4.
newsitem.headline: Wellman sees poor showings in Q3 and Q4.

text.p: Wellman Inc said Wednesday it expects to post a net loss in the third quarter and believes continued anemic market conditions will negatively affect its fourth quarter net earnings.

The anticipated third-quarter loss was attributed to difficult market conditions in Europe, "significant declines" in the prices of resin and a "substantially higher" quarterly tax rate to adjust for lower profitability.
The company also said it had to re-evaluate its inventory because of recent drops in the prices of raw materials.
Wellman said it expected its fourth quarter earnings would be affected by the continuation of these market conditions, leading to lower earnings than had been projected by analysts.
Analysts had projected fourth quarter earnings per share for Wellman at $0.41.
Wellman manufactures and markets polyester products and recycles plastics.
